baseline: 60452359f2f9faeb91a790445fb656f1c01f148b backend and original linker; 482b5f0 direct IR linker in linked/indexed arms. This is not a comparison with other languages or a final source cutover.

candidate.change: Index last use and first retaining use once; reuse definition/projection maps across C variants; release ownership/projection summaries after each emitted function, including exceptional exits.

environment.conditions: Quiet interleaved fresh processes, identical module preloads and output hash checks. Subject inference remote; no simultaneous local builds/tests/timings.

scoped.scope: Private C analysis indexing/memoization; exact ownership observations on every node including existing nonupdate errors, byte-identical C at both modes. No performance or all-target claim.

strict.scope: Strict public C emission artifact equality at both optimization settings; not A0-native strict support.

table.oracle: expected values: reference interpreter, confirmed by the independent BigInt oracle (tools/corpus.ts) when the table was generated

programs.name: arith
programs.about: u32 arithmetic wraps mod 2^32; div and rem are total; shifts use the low five bits

programs.name: logic
programs.about: bool logic, comparisons (unsigned), select computes both arms

programs.name: array
programs.about: array values: get reduces the index modulo the length, set returns a copy

programs.name: record
programs.about: records: rec, at, put (a copy), records inside arrays and arrays inside records

programs.name: iterate
programs.about: fold and loop: zero trips, extras, early stop by predicate, aggregate state, nesting

programs.name: calls
programs.about: call chains and the call/ID shorthand, callee results feeding callers

programs.name: bigret
programs.about: a u32 literal of 2^28 or more as the ret operand (the IR ret word packs 28 bits; larger literals are a kind-5 operand), alone and through callers

programs.name: biglit
programs.about: u32 literals of 2^28 or more (past the 28-bit value of the packed ret word) as add, xor, compare and select operands, fold initial states, literal-only calls the optimizer evaluates, and select operands at the ret

programs.name: text
programs.about: text literals are arrays of UTF-8 bytes with escapes

programs.name: io
programs.about: io tokens order effects: read (0 when exhausted), write, puts, folds that thread the stream

programs.name: checked
programs.about: the total checked ops return (value, ok): cadd/csub/cmul flag overflow, cdiv/crem a zero divisor, cget an index at or past the length

programs.name: strict_checked
programs.about: the checked ops give the same values under profile strict, and never trap

programs.name: strict_index
programs.about: profile strict: get/set at or past the length trap bounds (a dead get too, and a get in the untaken select arm), an index proved in range does not

programs.name: strict_div
programs.about: profile strict: div/rem by zero trap divzero (a dead div too); a divisor proved nonzero does not; the first trap in node order wins

programs.name: strict_wrap
programs.about: profile strict: add, sub, mul and the shifts still wrap and mask; they never trap

programs.name: strict_iterate
programs.about: profile strict: a trap in a fold or loop body names the node, the trip and the call chain; an aggregate-state fold updated in place traps before it writes

programs.name: strict_io
programs.about: profile strict: a read after the last input word traps input (inside a fold too); within the input it reads as usual

programs.name: chainrot
programs.about: chains of one associative op (add, mul, xor, and, or) whose late operand is a product: the optimizer rotates the chain so the late operand joins last (a latency model, no change of value), with literals, shared inner nodes and chains through calls

scope.change: Release per-function ownership/projection analysis after all C variants have been emitted, including exceptions. Preserve the first persistent-cache experiment and its memory data.

retainedMemory.scope: Controlled retained-memory probe, separate from timing runs. Every child preloads all three backends and two linkers equally. Full GC before source parsing and twice after emission. Input source map, typed project and compiled C text explicitly rooted after GC. One warmup plus five measured rotating rounds; fresh process for each cell. No timing or native C runtime claim. Every emitted C hash matches the frozen baseline.

interpretation: Preserve both performance runs, including every slower median and RSS/heap increase. The final scoped run has a Canonical frame-helper slowdown and small memory increases in some cells. Full GC measurements retain source, input typed IR and C output; they diagnose live memory separately from garbage collection timing. No blanket absence of regressions or production syntax eligibility is established.
